Android requires an ongoing notification for a background sync service. Without it the service cannot keep running.

Android only lets the app holding the current window read the clipboard. When you copy something, Synco briefly adds a tiny invisible window to take input focus for a few milliseconds, reads the clip, then removes the window. Because of this, focus flickers to Synco for an instant each time you copy. Synco reads only right after a copy and never inspects the contents of your screen.
Background clipboard capture is off. Turn on Synco clipboard access so copies made in other apps reach your Mac.
Clipboard access is on. Copy something in any app and Synco will pick it up.
Shizuku is reading the clipboard. Copy anything and Synco picks it up straight away.
Battery optimisation can suspend the network connection while the screen is off, which makes copies arrive minutes late or not at all. Synco will ask you right here, no digging through Settings.

This phone gets a brand new device identity and fingerprint. Every device you have already paired with will no longer recognise this phone, so you have to pair with your Mac again. Nothing else is deleted.

Synco could not read this phone\'s saved identity, so sync cannot start. This usually follows a system update that invalidated the phone\'s key store. Nothing has been changed. You can create a new identity, but every device you paired with will need to pair again.
The clipboard cannot be read right now. Turn on Synco clipboard access to fix this.
No usable network. Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi network as your Mac.

Synco could not open its network listener, so no connection can be made.

Files from your Mac are saved where you cannot browse them. Choose a folder to fix that. Android will not let you pick Download or the storage root itself, so open one and pick a folder inside it, or make a new one.
Anything bigger than this is refused in both directions. Your Mac has its own limit, and the smaller of the two wins.
Synco keeps this phone and your Mac sharing one clipboard over your local network. Nothing leaves your network and there is no account.

Accessibility works on any phone but has to flash focus for an instant on each copy, so it can occasionally miss one. Shizuku is more reliable and never touches focus, but you have to start Shizuku after each reboot.
